summary: Staff-sale crash repair vs mutable catalog inputs (op-convert + group draw-down)

comments.body:
<!-- sdlc:stage=backlog kind=readiness -->
From TKT-79 ai-review (gpt-5.6-sol, finding 1, triaged incidental/pre-existing): the ADR-023 staff-sale seam (operational convert AND group draw-down) repairs a crash between the inventory commit and the commerce reservation insert by replaying the same request, reconstructing the inventory fingerprint from *live catalog data*. Today ticket-type price/slot are create-only, so reconstruction is stable and the repair always works. If catalog pricing ever becomes mutable (TKT-5/TKT-17 territory), an intervening price change makes the replay fingerprint mismatch (409) and strands a committed carve with no commerce reservation. Options sketched by the reviewer: persist the catalog snapshot/intent before calling inventory, or add an inventory replay-by-key lookup that does not require reconstructed inputs. Gate this ticket on (or fold it into) whichever pricing ticket introduces mutability. Not shaped; DoR pending.

description: Harden the shared commerce staff-sale seam against mutable catalog inputs during crash repair. Pre-existing behavior shipped with TKT-77 (ADR-023); TKT-79 clones it. Blocking precondition in the wild: catalog price mutability, which does not exist yet.
